services.name: Travel Exhibit
services.desc: The cost is dependent on location, duration, and number/types of accompanying programs. For more information regarding cost, fill out the interest form below and we can talk through those details in our intake meeting. A representative from the museum will transport and set up the banners in the provided space before the exhibit opening. The partnering organization only has to make entry available to the space and communicate location requirements in the space. We ask that for local exhibits (within a 6 hour radius via car) the exhibit stand for no less than 4 weeks.
